payload.summary: Reconciliation note: two of the four Therapy source findings queued on 2026-09-16 are already implemented, and one carried a wrong claim
payload.detail: Applies to the four add requests queued in commit c6a882554. (1) The P1 'false Source 100% meter' item is IMPLEMENTED by commit 37d6eddf6: sourceCompleteness is null on all 205 records, the catalogue asset and site-content manifest baseline were regenerated, and npm run test passed (1363 files, 20632 tests). Close it on reconciliation. (2) The P2 'six owner-reviewed ledger sources' item is IMPLEMENTED by commit 2f7072e43, with one residual: all six records remain validationStatus locally_reviewed from the owner's 2026-09-06 sign-off, which predates the corrections, so each still needs owner re-attestation. Keep a row open for that re-attestation only. (3) CORRECTION to that same request: it claimed the wrong publication dates overstated the Currency dimension by about ten years. False. Currency is scored from documentStatus alone (current 15, review_due 8, unknown 4, outdated 0) in src/lib/sources/catalogue-core.ts; publicationDate contributes only a boolean to traceability. Measured: the five Chief Psychiatrist guidelines score 91 band A both before and after. Only the RANZCP documentStatus change moved a score, band A to B, 89 to 74. (4) The publisher-register and candidate-adoption items remain open and unchanged.
